foundationalObjective.wording: Identify and use the x-axis, y-axis, origin, and four quadrants of the Cartesian plane, including interpreting positive and negative coordinates.

SPI.MIDDLE.GEO.COORD.CARTESIAN_PLANE.01.wording: Identify and use the x-axis, y-axis, origin, and four quadrants of the Cartesian plane, including interpreting positive and negative coordinates.

SPI.MIDDLE.GEO.COORD.READ_POINT.01.wording: Read the coordinates of a point plotted on a labelled Cartesian grid and state them as an ordered pair, with the x-coordinate first.

SPI.MIDDLE.GEO.COORD.PLOT_POINT.01.wording: Plot a point accurately on a labelled Cartesian grid from a given ordered pair.

SPI.MIDDLE.GEO.COORD.GRADIENT_TWO_POINTS.wording: Calculate the gradient of the non-vertical line through two lattice points as an exact integer or fraction.

SPI.MIDDLE.GEO.COORD.MIDPOINT.01.wording: Calculate the midpoint of the line segment joining two points and state it as an exact ordered pair.

SPI.MIDDLE.GEO.COORD.INTERPRET_MX_C.01.wording: Identify the gradient m and y-intercept c in a linear equation written in the form y = mx + c.

SPI.MIDDLE.GEO.COORD.EQUATION_FROM_GRAPH.wording: Determine the equation y = mx + c of a non-vertical straight line shown on a coordinate grid.

SPI.MIDDLE.GEO.COORD.EQUATION_FROM_2PTS..wording: Determine the equation y = mx + c of the non-vertical line passing through two given points.
